entradas.text: “I was doing well until you gave me a call.”
entradas.menu: “I was doing well until you gave me a call.”

entradas.text: I was sipping my first cup of coffee for the day when the phone lit up and rang.
I picked up the phone.
I swore under my breath. I thought my schedule was clear for at least half an hour.
“It definitely was.”
“Mr. President. How are you doing on this fine day, if I may ask?”
“Sorry, I know it's underwhelming. I bet you wish you'd gone for a bigger buy-in earlier.”
"I'm fine. You?”
entradas.menu: "I'm fine. You?”

entradas.text: “What is it, Gus?”
entradas.menu: “What is it, Gus?”

entradas.text: “I am calling you because I just heard from the CEO of Armadine Industries, Arron Bridges, regarding the recent initial public offering on the Ventrie City Stock Exchange.”
“Business as usual on my end. Thanks for asking."
“Oh, come on. You are the president! Nobody got to that seat without taking massive risks.”
“Well. I will take that. Thank you.”
“As you might've guessed, it's about our massive venture investment of 3000 shares worth nearly three million ren.”
“Thanks to the ongoing trade war, I was told that the Armadine stock prices plunged after the IPO. The markets are very volatile right now.”
“You will love it.”
“I'm not much of a risk taker.”
entradas.menu: “I'm not much of a risk taker.”

entradas.text: “Don't worry. Our stocks are still secure and they advised us not to sell because a recovery is expected in the near future.”
“However, this means that we have not made any profits, and on the contrary have lost fifty percent of the value compared to our initial purchase.”
“It is. Trust me.”
“Darn it. Yes, I do.”
entradas.menu: “Darn it. Yes, I do.”

entradas.text: “I'm sorry, Mr. President.”
“It was a good start for sure.”
entradas.menu: “It was a good start for sure.”

entradas.text: “I knew I shouldn't have listened to your advice.”
entradas.menu: “I knew I shouldn't have listened to your advice.”

entradas.text: “Why are you apologizing? It's not your fault.”
entradas.menu: “Why are you apologizing? It's not your fault.”

entradas.text: “You know what they say. Don't invest what you can't afford to lose.”
entradas.menu: “You know what they say. Don't invest what you can't afford to lose.”

entradas.text: “It was risky, yes. But look at where we are now!”
“Isn't that great?”
“At the time, I thought Armadine was a sure bet. This trade war came out of nowhere."
“Thank you for understanding the unfortunate situation.”
“Great news! So, how much did we gain?”
entradas.menu: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”

entradas.text: “Yes. It's great. Go on.”
entradas.menu: “Yes. It's great. Go on.”

entradas.text: “Wasn't Konrath Koronti the one that said that? He was a visionary for the free world for sure.”
“This better be worth it.”
entradas.menu: “This better be worth it.”

entradas.text: “Regardless, we still have a hold on our stocks.”
“The shares have doubled in price at the IPO in the VCSE and we will soon receive the profits made from the investment.”
“Exactly. Electronics manufacturing has a great future and Armadine seems to have a head start.”
“I am confident once the effects of this nasty trade war subside, we'll recover the value of our shares and then some."
“I am very pleased to say that we have made gains!”
“That's all I wanted to talk to you about, Mr. President.”
“Goodbye for now.”
“Remind me never to do business with you ever again.”
entradas.menu: “Remind me never to do business with you ever again.”

entradas.text: “Keep me up to date on other opportunities.”
entradas.menu: “Keep me up to date on other opportunities.”

entradas.text: “I knew it was the right call to trust you on this.”
entradas.menu: “I knew it was the right call to trust you on this.”

entradas.text: “Again, I am so sorry."
“I'll let you know immediately when new opportunities arise.”
“Very well. Talk to you later then.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. Talk to you later then.”

entradas.text: “It's all thanks to you.”
entradas.menu: “It's all thanks to you.”

entradas.text: “I assure you, this will pale in comparison to what we will do together in the future.”
“Some things are just worth taking the risk for.”
entradas.menu: “Some things are just worth taking the risk for.”

entradas.text: The line dropped.
“I have a good eye for investments.”
entradas.menu: “I have a good eye for investments.”

entradas.text: “Instead of suffering losses due to market volatility like most public firms in Merkopa, we actually came out unscathed. Arcasia wasn't influenced by the Black Tuesday crash!”
“It could have been much worse, but we got out of it with the best outcome. Isn't that great?”
“Great news! So, how much did we gain?”
entradas.menu: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”

entradas.text: “Unbelievable. How can you say that when the Sordish economy is crippled?”
entradas.menu: “Unbelievable. How can you say that when the Sordish economy is crippled?”

entradas.text: “I think so too.”
“You are right, Mr. President. I'm sorry.”
“This is the beginning of a good partnership. Keep it up.”
entradas.menu: “This is the beginning of a good partnership. Keep it up.”

entradas.text: “You're going to want to sit down."
“That, you do. Did you read Konrath Koronti's book on entrepreneurship, by any chance? Everything I know about the market, I learned from him.”
“In total we have made...”
“It's not great on our end, either. Some of our investments are suffering due to Black Tuesday.”
“So you're telling me I spent a fortune on this investment and got nothing back?!”
entradas.menu: “So you're telling me I spent a fortune on this investment and got nothing back?!”

entradas.text: “Fair point. I would have felt worse if your investment was larger.”
“At least we didn't invest much and have no direct losses.”
entradas.menu: “At least we didn't invest much and have no direct losses.”

entradas.text: “I know it's not great. But no one saw the trade war coming.”
“As you might've guessed, it's about our significant venture investment of 2000 shares worth nearly two million ren.”
“As you might've guessed, it's about our little venture investment of 1000 shares worth nearly a million ren.”
“Let's hope so. I want to trust you Gus.”
entradas.menu: “Let's hope so. I want to trust you Gus.”

entradas.text: “I doubt it. Sell all of our stocks and cut our losses."
entradas.menu: “I doubt it. Sell all of our stocks and cut our losses." [+1 Personal Wealth]

entradas.text: “Very well, sir. I will arrange it and make the transfer to your personal bank account.”
“Anything else?”
entradas.menu: “Anything else?”

entradas.text: “The shares have doubled in price at the IPO in the VCSE and we will soon receive the profits made from the investment.”
“Appreciate it.”
“...nearly two million Sordish Ren!”
“...nearly four million Sordish Ren!”
“...nearly three million Sordish Ren!”
“The money will be transferred to your personal bank account shortly.”
“Mr. President. How are you?”
“Not so great. You must have seen what is going on.”
entradas.menu: “Not so great. You must have seen what is going on.”

entradas.text: “Eh. You?”
entradas.menu: “Eh. You?”

entradas.text: “The trade war has us on edge. We've been working on mitigation measures for the rural economy.”
“You bet I have."
“Oh, I almost forgot.”
“The management sent you one of their brand new radios as a gift. Ms. Suno will bring it to you."
He didn't laugh.
He laughed out loud.
"Don't fret. It's not one of *those* calls."
